label: chat import reader • Claude Code, Copilot, and OpenCode agent files from one repo
notes: Claude Code `agents/*.md` is a fast path. Copilot `.github/agents/*.agent.md` and OpenCode `.opencode/agent/*.md` sit outside an `agents/` folder, so the reader must report them as agents pointing at their documents.

name: security-reviewer

tools: Read, Grep, Glob

tools: ['edit', 'search']
---
# Docs Writer

You write clear documentation for this repository. Keep a friendly tone and update the README when features change.

mode: subagent
tools:

---
